summary:
Speed display is implemented for both entry points, but I did not run tests, mypy, or black, per the instructions, so everything is verified by reading only.

Changes:
- rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gains show_speed (default False) and a static render_speed(speed) that uses filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix with the specified suffixes and base 1000, formats one decimal place, and appends " it/s" in the progress.percentage style; None renders as empty text. render returns speed text when the total is unknown and show_speed is on, using finished_speed or speed; otherwise the existing path runs unchanged. Class docstring now documents all constructor args. Module-level track() gains show_speed (default True), documented and passed to TaskProgressColumn. Progress.track declares task_total as Optional[float] and sets None instead of raising for a non-Sized iterable with no total.
- CHANGELOG.md: one line under Unreleased / Added.
- tests/test_progress.py: added test_task_progress_column_speed; removed the two ValueError blocks in test_track and test_progress_track with no replacement.

Choices and open points:
- The default column list in Progress.__init__ still uses TaskProgressColumn() with no show_speed, since the spec did not cover it.
- Removing the ValueError blocks means track(5) now fails with TypeError when iterated, and the existing test bodies that loop over track(5) were removed entirely, so no test covers that path. Confirm that is the intended behavior.
- No commit was made.
